IMPORTANT NOTE: The weight of cocopeat is 5kg when packed, but it may get reduced to 3.8kg due to weather changes. As the cocopeat absorbs moisture, it expands & returns to its original volume. It is common for natural cocopeat to experience weight loss due to weather conditions because it is composed of 98% cocopeat. Many brands mix cocopeat with sand in 50:50 ratio to maintain the weight of mixture. The weight, however, may vary when using natural cocopeat, depending on the moisture levels.
IDEAL MEDIUM FOR SEEDLINGS: When transplanting seedlings into the ground or into another pot, this cocopeat acts as an ideal medium that balances the texture and strength of the soil, providing an ideal environment for seedlings to grow.
MADE FROM NATURAL MATERIALS: The cocopeat is made from natural washed Coco Fiber, providing an eco-friendly and sustainable option for gardeners who are looking to use organic materials.
EXCEPTIONAL WATER HOLDING CAPACITY: Oriley Cocopeat has exceptional water holding capacity, maintaining high porosity and drainage abilities, which can help to create an optimal growing environment for plants.
